material.title: How a tier-1 supplier cut changeover time by 40% with SMED
material.bodyOriginal: Over six months, a tier-1 automotive supplier reduced average changeover time on three stamping lines from 50 to 30 minutes using SMED workshops led by operators. The team separated internal and external setup, standardized die carts and added a daily review of changeover data. OEE on the lines rose from 61% to 69%.
